title: SAGE: Scale-Aware Gradual Evolution for Continual Knowledge Graph Embedding

problem.claim: Continual knowledge graph embedding must update embeddings for newly added facts while preserving learned knowledge in dynamically evolving knowledge graphs.

gap.claim: Existing continual knowledge graph embedding methods often fail to account for varying update scales and lack systematic evaluation throughout the update process.

contributions.claim: SAGE is a scale-aware gradual evolution framework for continual knowledge graph embedding.
SAGE determines embedding dimensions from update scales and expands the embedding space accordingly.
SAGE uses Dynamic Distillation to balance preserving learned knowledge with incorporating new facts.

author_reported_evidence.claim: Experiments on seven benchmarks reportedly show that SAGE consistently outperforms existing baselines, improving MRR by 1.38%, H@1 by 1.25%, and H@10 by 1.6%.
Comparisons with fixed-dimension methods reportedly show optimal performance for SAGE on every snapshot.

narrative_sequence.summary: Knowledge graph embedding methods primarily represent entities and relations in low-dimensional spaces for static graphs, while real-world knowledge graphs evolve continuously.
Continual knowledge graph embedding methods update embeddings for new facts while attempting to preserve learned knowledge.
Existing methods do not adequately address varying update scales or systematically evaluate the full update process.
SAGE adapts embedding dimensions to update scales, expands the embedding space, and applies Dynamic Distillation.
The authors report improvements over baselines and optimal snapshot performance compared with fixed-dimension methods.

source_observation.claim: The method adapts embedding dimensions according to the scale of updates and expands the embedding space accordingly.

interpretation.claim: Representation capacity may need to scale with the magnitude of continual changes rather than remain fixed.

application.claim: For evolving representation-learning systems, consider making model capacity responsive to measured update scale.

exception.claim: The abstract does not specify when adaptive dimensions are unsuitable or how update scales should be measured.

source_observation.claim: Dynamic Distillation is used to balance retaining learned knowledge with incorporating new facts.

interpretation.claim: Continual learning requires an explicit tradeoff between stability and adaptation.

application.claim: Use distillation or a comparable retention mechanism when updating models under changing data.

exception.claim: The abstract does not provide the mechanism's objective, weighting, or behavior under different update regimes.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the seven benchmarks, baseline methods, or experimental settings.
The abstract does not describe the Dynamic Distillation objective or the procedure for determining embedding dimensions.
